10 Tips to Pass a Prop Firm Challenge

Passing a prop firm challenge is mostly about risk management, not finding more winning trades. These tips come from traders who have passed multiple evaluations.

Respect the daily loss limit

Size positions so that three losing trades in a row cannot breach the daily loss. The daily loss limit ends more evaluations than the profit target does.

Trade fewer setups

Pick two setups you know well and ignore the rest during the evaluation. Overtrading is the fastest way to hit the drawdown.

Plan for the profit split

Once funded, understand how the profit split and payout schedule work so you do not rush trades before a payout date.
